hero.title: Your virtual shop assistant is here to help
hero.description: Coolhat is an AI-powered webstore front builder for SMEs. It gives every shop a virtual assistant that already knows all your products, helps customers find the right items, and connects orders straight into Telegram so owners can manage everything from their phone.
hero.highlights: Live Telegram assistant ? Product-aware AI ? Storefront in days
hero.question: Do you have something for sensitive skin under $20?
hero.answerIntro: I've found 3 products that match: all fragrance-free, made for sensitive skin and in your budget.
hero.answerOutro: Reply with the product number and I'll create a checkout link for you.
hero.footer: Powered by your real product catalog, checkout flow, and Telegram Mini App - not a generic chatbot.

features.title: One assistant for your customers and your team.
features.description: Coolhat combines an AI product expert, storefront builder, and Telegram Mini App into one simple flow, so small shops can sell online with the same experience as bigger brands.

ai.title: AI that knows your products
ai.description: Coolhat connects directly to your real catalog, so the assistant can answer questions about ingredients, stock, pricing, and bundles instead of guessing.

telegram.title: Built for Telegram first
telegram.description: SME owners live in Telegram. Coolhat sends orders, updates, and customer chats straight to your phone so you don't need to learn a new dashboard.

storefront.title: From idea to storefront in days
storefront.description: Start from a simple description of your shop. Coolhat helps you generate products, copy, and a shoppable storefront without hiring a full dev team.

how.title: From product idea to AI-assisted storefront in three steps.

one.title: Describe your shop
one.description: Tell Coolhat about your products, pricing, and customers. It turns that into a ready-to-share storefront and product catalog.

two.title: Connect your Telegram
two.description: Link the channel you already use every day. New orders, buyer questions, and updates land right there.

three.title: Let the AI handle it
three.description: Your AI assistant answers product questions, recommends items, and generates clean checkout links for buyers.

pricing.title: Simple plans for growing SMEs.
pricing.description: Start free for 14 days. No credit card required. Scale as your business grows.

footer.copyright: Helping SMEs sell with an AI shop assistant.
